overview_description.description:
ZBiotics is a synthetic biology company founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company bioengineers probiotic bacteria for nutraceutical and other applications.

ZBiotics is pioneering the use of genetically engineered probiotics to solve intractable problems.

product.name: ZBiotics Pre-Alcohol
product.description: A probiotic drink containing engineered Bacillus subtilis ZB183™ that produces an acetaldehyde-digesting enzyme in the gut during and after alcohol consumption.

product.name: ZBiotics Sugar-to-Fiber
product.description: A daily probiotic drink mix containing engineered Bacillus subtilis ZB423™ that converts some dietary sucrose into levan, a soluble prebiotic fiber, in the gut.
